title: Rava bar Yishmael
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Moed Katan 6b: “Rava bar Yishmael said — and some say Rav Yeima bar Shelamya.” In Ketubot 10b: Rava son of Rabbi Yishmael.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied alternative is רב יימא בר שלמיה, Rav Yeima bar Shelamya. The William Davidson digital texts of Moed Katan 6b and Ketubot 10b have רב יימר בר שלמיא, Rav Yeimar bar Shelamya. The supplied name is preserved without silently adding a resh or asserting a printing history.
The two consulted passages support the different forms of the patronymic cited by Hyman; the alternative Yeima/Yeimar spelling remains as noted above.
